snippet.title: Cutout - Exclusive Gameplay and Demo Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
Dismember your enemies and steal their limbs to gain new powers in this side-scrolling action horror game set in a grim, handcrafted fairy tale world made of paper. Rebuild Lena, child of the forest, and shape who she becomes through the choices you make.

Wishlist: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3792130/Cutout/
